title: Add VSCode RAG DevLoop extension and Node starter kit
author: Anita Rao
description: Motivation: speed up developer feedback loop for RAG workflows by providing an editor-integrated playground that wires up a local vector store, model endpoint, and typed tool bindings. This PR introduces a lightweight VSCode extension that exposes a "DevLoop" panel for iterating on prompts, tool wiring, and embeddings without leaving the editor, plus a Node starter that demonstrates Repository, Retriever, and Tool patterns with the Redwood SDK. What this contains: - VSCode extension (vscode-extension/) with a DevLoop panel that streams model output, shows token-level latency, and can invoke sample tools (search, function call stub) via a local HTTP shim. - Node starter (node-starters/rag-node-starter/) that includes a minimal express-based local tool shim, sample VectorStore adapter (sqlite-backed), typed tool definitions, README quickstart and test prompts. - Docs update: adds a quickstart page under redwood-docs/examples/rag-devloop-vscode.md with screenshots and a short screencast link. - CI: adds a GitHub Actions job to build and smoke-test the VSCode extension and run unit tests for the starter. - Telemetry opt-in: extension defaults to telemetry off; uses local debug key support and instructs users to wire REDWOOD_API_KEY via .env for hosted testing. Checklist: - [x] VSCode extension manifest and basic telemetry gating - [x] Node starter with README and example prompts - [x] CI build for extension and tests - [x] Docs quickstart page and demo recording link - [x] Security review: no secrets committed; README explains safe local testing How to try locally (summary): 1) cd vscode-extension && npm install && npm run build && code --install-extension ./out/rag-devloop-vscode.vsix 2) open the DevLoop panel (View > DevLoop), pick the local starter configuration, press Run. 3) Start the node starter (node node-starters/rag-node-starter/index.js) and try the sample prompt set. Related work: Linear ENG-3421 (VSCode RAG devloop), references to existing quickstarts and the Playground initiative. Notes: kept scope intentionally small to avoid extension feature creep (no full language server). This PR is focused on a devloop preview for examples and docs; productionization (Marketplace publishing, deep key management integration) will be follow-ups.

Start node starter: cd node-starters/rag-node-starter && npm ci && npm run seed && npm start
Open any workspace in VSCode, open View -> DevLoop panel, select 'Local Starter', run sample prompt set and observe streaming tokens and tooling invocations
Run unit tests: repo root: npm run test:node-starters
